owner_decisions.question: What history becomes shareable when an owner grants a friend?
owner_decisions.recommended_default: Prospective from that per-friend grant's effective time; unknown historical evidence is not retrospectively shared.

owner_decisions.question: What projection and sensitive-place policy should Friends use?
owner_decisions.recommended_default: Server-derived coarse cell/region projection, no raw points/timestamps, sensitive places excluded by default; approve the product resolution before implementation.

owner_decisions.question: How long may last-authorized friend data remain available offline?
owner_decisions.recommended_default: At most 24 hours with last-checked context; purge on account switch and online revocation; no new shared data offline. Alternative: no shared offline cache.

owner_decisions.question: What should single-friend and overlap views mean?
owner_decisions.recommended_default: Single friend shows only that source; self remains separately selectable; union preserves per-source identity and overlap.

owner_decisions.question: Is prospective presence-gated friend Cairn Encounter included in v1?
owner_decisions.recommended_default: Yes: canonical real evidence only, no automatic author notification, and explicit Route access remains separate. If declined, exclude friend Cairn discovery from v1.
